args.command: which pdf-tools pdfinfo pdftk qpdf 2>/dev/null; ls -la /work/report.pdf 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.local/bin 2>/dev/null; ls /usr/local/bin 2>/dev/null | head -50; type pdf-tools 2>/dev/null; echo PATH=$PATH

pdfinfo /work/report.pdf 2>/dev/null || python3 -c "import pypdf; print(len(pypdf.PdfReader('/work/report.pdf').pages))" 2>/dev/null || python3 -c "from PyPDF2 import PdfReader; print(len(PdfReader('/work/report.pdf').pages))" 2>/dev/null || ls -la /work/
